description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_ElementDef, which encapsulates the structure and behavior of an HTML element definition used in an HTML sanitization library. It includes properties for attributes, content models, child definitions, and methods for merging definitions potentially from multiple sources.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_ElementDef
classes.description: A class representing the definition of an HTML element, including attributes, content model, child content, and merge capabilities for extending or combining element definitions.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to create a new standalone HTML element definition with specified content model, content model type, and attributes.

methods.name: mergeIn
methods.description: Merges another HTMLPurifier_ElementDef into this one, prioritizing values from the new definition where applicable, and merging associative arrays and properties.
